content: Hello, this is Susan with Heritage Estates Event Services. How can I assist you regarding the Johnson Family Fund transfer or any previous payments today?
Hi Susan, I just wanted to make sure the $4,000 wire from my uncle's account ending in 7826 was correctly applied to the reunion venue deposit. There was a reference code on the transfer, JFR2024.

Thank you for confirming those details, Mark. Yes, the wire transfer of $4,000 from Samuel Johnson's account ending 7826, reference JFR2024, was received at 9:14 AM this morning, and credited under 'Johnson Family Reunion 2024' on our system.
Great, I noticed the payment shows as pending on my uncle's side. Should it clear by the end of today?

Absolutely, most domestic wires to our Heritage Estates CitiBank account (IBAN US65CITI00038294714) are finalized within hours. Given the urgency for your reservation, our team expedited the confirmation. You should see the final status by 5 PM Eastern.
Thanks, and my aunt's Zelle transfer of $800 from her address, elaine.johnson@gmail.com, for the catering add-on, did that process too?

Yes, Elaine Johnson's Zelle payment of $800, sent yesterday at 4:27 PM, was logged under your group's event package. Her email, elaine.johnson@gmail.com, is now linked to your event for all future payment receipts.
That's a relief. My cousin Sam wants to confirm his phone number, 917-555-6612, is the primary contact for event updates.

Confirmed, Sam Johnson's mobile, 917-555-6612, is currently set as the primary point of contact for the Johnson Family Reunion. We'll send all time-sensitive updates there, especially regarding payment clearances and venue access codes.
Perfect. If any issue arises with the bank transfers before Friday, will you notify us immediately?

Of course, Mark. If there's any delay or discrepancy with either the $4,000 wire (ref JFR2024) or the $800 Zelle payment, we'll alert both you and your designated contacts right away, no action required on your end unless you hear otherwise.
